records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_scale#1
records.source: The whole-GUI scale (:mod:`spacr.qt.gui_scale`) is fixed at startup and applies everywhere. A preview wants its own: a Mask preview on a laptop may need to shrink its controls to give the images room, while the settings beside it stay readable. Every preview -- Mask, Measure, Plaque, Timelapse, Motility and the image-UMAP views -- installs the same control through :func:`install_preview_scale`, so there is one implementation of it.
records.context: The whole-GUI scale (:mod:`spacr.qt.gui_scale`) is fixed at startup and applies everywhere. A preview wants its own: a Mask preview on a laptop may need to shrink its controls to give the images room, while the settings beside it stay readable. Every preview -- Mask, Measure, Plaque, Timelapse, Motility and the image-UMAP views -- installs the same control through :func:`install_preview_scale`, so there is one implementation of it.
records.translation: 整个 GUI 的缩放（:mod:`spacr.qt.gui_scale`）在启动时固定并作用于所有地方。而预览需要自己的缩放：笔记本电脑上的 Mask 预览可能需要缩小其控件，为图像腾出空间，同时让旁边的设置保持可读。每个预览——Mask、Measure、Plaque、Timelapse、Motility 以及各 image-UMAP 视图——都通过 :func:`install_preview_scale` 安装同一个控件，因此它只有一种实现。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_scale#10
records.source: A WINDOW OPENED FROM THE PREVIEW IS NOT THE PREVIEW (item 522). A dialog parented to the panel is a window of its own, yet Qt cascades the panel's scaled sheet into it, and the walk found it among the panel's children: at 150 % a settings dialog's buttons were 59 px tall, not the 40 px of every other dialog. Such a window and everything in it are kept at 100 %, and the window's own sheet re-states, at 100 %, the sizes it would otherwise inherit scaled -- set as it is polished, so before it is first laid out.
records.context: A window opened from the preview is not the preview (item 522). A dialog parented to the panel is a window of its own, yet Qt cascades the panel's scaled sheet into it, and the walk found it among the panel's children: at 150 % a settings dialog's buttons were 59 px tall, not the 40 px of every other dialog. Such a window and everything in it are kept at 100 %, and the window's own sheet re-states, at 100 %, the sizes it would otherwise inherit scaled -- set as it is polished, so before it is first laid out.
records.translation: “从预览中打开的窗口不属于预览”（第 522 项）。以面板为父对象的对话框本身是一个独立窗口，但 Qt 会把面板的缩放样式表级联到其中，而遍历也会在面板的子对象中找到它：在 150 % 时，某个设置对话框的按钮高 59 px，而不是其他所有对话框的 40 px。这样的窗口及其中的所有内容都保持在 100 %，并且该窗口自身的样式表会在 100 % 下重新声明原本会以缩放形式继承的尺寸——在其 polish 时设置，因此在首次布局之前生效。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_scale#8
records.source: Each value's own base is remembered on the widget, so scaling is always from the size the code asked for and never compounds. A size the code sets again later becomes the new base. At 100 % nothing is touched at all -- no sheet, no size, no property -- so a preview at its default scale is the preview it was before this module existed.
records.context: Each value's own base is remembered on the widget, so scaling is always from the size the code asked for and never compounds. A size the code sets again later becomes the new base. At 100 % nothing is touched at all -- no sheet, no size, no property -- so a preview at its default scale is the preview it was before this module existed.
records.translation: 每个值自身的基准值都记录在控件上，因此缩放总是基于代码所请求的尺寸，永远不会累积。代码之后再次设置的尺寸会成为新的基准值。在 100 % 时完全不做任何改动（没有样式表、没有尺寸、没有属性），因此默认缩放下的预览与本模块出现之前完全相同。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)
